newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Robeco group launches string of sub-funds.
newsitem.headline: Robeco group launches string of sub-funds.

text.p: The Robeco NV Group of investment funds said on Thursday it was introducing five new sub-funds of its Interest Plus Funds, aimed at the introduction of the single European currency.
The five new sub-funds, to be listed on the stock exchange from April 15, have been awarded an Aaa rating by Moody's Investors Service.
"The new sub-funds have been set up with an eye on the introduction of the euro and the associated growth in demand for investment in hard currencies," Robeco said in a statement.
The new sub-funds -- RG Money Plus Funds in dollars and Swiss francs and RG Bond Plus Funds in dollars, Swiss francs and Belgian francs -- will be managed by Robeco Groep in Rotterdam.
The Money Plus funds aim to generate a return in excess of that generated by six month deposits without currency risk.
The Bond Plus funds invest in fixed interest securities and aim to generate a higher return than that on two-year deposits.
The risk profile is low and the investments have an international spread.
Investors can subscribe to the shares free of charge during the introduction period, which runs from April 15 to May 30.
